obligations.requirement: The live DebugSnapshot is a bounded structured envelope with Stamp, Coherence, Product, Axiom, Arc, Platform, Telemetry, and Activity domains; the global Capability/CapabilityState array is removed.
obligations.oracle: PX0DebugSnapshot contract tests compile against the exact envelope, use a dependent-member check to prove DebugSnapshot has no capabilities member, and round-trip the structured snapshot through MutexCopySnapshotChannel.
obligations.acceptance: No live Capability[] bag remains in snapshot.hpp or platform snapshot construction and the structured snapshot is copyable/default-safe.

obligations.requirement: Each owner domain has independent DebugAvailability state and one absent/degraded provider cannot prevent other domains from remaining usable.
obligations.oracle: Snapshot assembler tests cover null Arc with Product/Axiom/Platform/Telemetry still populated, absent provider -> Unsupported, and Platform surfaceAvailable=false -> Degraded.
obligations.acceptance: Section availability follows the frozen availability rule and current panels derive their legacy availability from sections rather than a global capability bitset.

obligations.requirement: Common capture validates product identity without a global Runtime lock and retries at most once.
obligations.oracle: Fake RuntimeFacade sequences prove: stable first attempt -> Coherent; first attempt changes then second stabilizes -> Coherent; both attempts change -> MixedGeneration; missing Runtime -> Stale.
obligations.acceptance: Tests also assert read counts so capture performs no more than two full attempts/four RuntimeState reads per capture.

obligations.requirement: Common assembler owns timestamp/snapshot sequencing while preserving the owner sequence used by current control deadlines.
obligations.oracle: Tests assert snapshotSequence increments per capture, stamp.sequence equals TelemetrySnapshot.sequence when telemetry exists, monotonicTimeNs is populated, frameId prefers telemetry.canonicalFrames then platform.presentCount, and identity fields come from the published Product projection.
obligations.acceptance: Current Debug UI command deadline behavior is not silently rebased onto an unrelated assembler-local counter.

obligations.requirement: Windows and Web stop assembling DebugSnapshot fields locally and use DebugSnapshotAssembler with owner providers.
obligations.oracle: Repository structural tests assert Windows buildDebugSnapshot(...) and Web debugSnapshot(...) are absent, DebugSnapshotAssembler is present in both composition roots, Web provides an IArcDiagnostics adapter for the existing preview/input/handoff observations, and no replacement platform-local field-mapping function exists.
obligations.acceptance: Platform code constructs provider/source objects and calls assembler.capture(); snapshot domain mapping lives only in common debug_ui assembler code.
obligations.evidence_required: Windows/Web structural pytest contracts plus exact source diff

obligations.requirement: The current Debug UI remains buildable and preserves current product-control, Surface-control, selection, Brush/Eraser, telemetry, receipt display, input-capture, and active-stroke throttling behavior while reading the structured snapshot.
obligations.oracle: DUI20DebugUiContracts, DUIM1PanelModel, PX0RuntimeFacadeContract, DUIM1RuntimeFacade, DUIM1ViewControls, Windows/Web structural tests pass; source review confirms controller/windows_host only read structured sections and existing active-stroke throttling/input-capture code remains.
obligations.acceptance: No layout/workbench redesign is introduced and current control paths remain owner-routed.
obligations.evidence_required: frozen regression set at exact result revision

obligations.requirement: PX0-02 preserves current last Product/Surface receipt observation through DebugSnapshot.activity without implementing the PX0-03 bounded Activity Log.
obligations.oracle: Snapshot tests exercise DebugActivitySource passthrough; Windows current last receipts are exposed through that source; no activity_log.hpp/.cpp or request-history buffer is added.
obligations.acceptance: Existing receipt rows can continue to render, while full activity history/routing remains absent.

obligations.requirement: PX0-02 does not enter PX0-03+ architecture, Preview repair, or physical evidence closure.
obligations.oracle: Exact diff contains no DebugControlRouter, DebugActivityLog, Workspace/PanelRegistry/Workbench, generic DebugCommand retirement, preview visibility repair, or .aegis/results/GT-DUI-M1 mutation.
obligations.acceptance: Scope remains structured observation only and no physical/Gate PASS claim is added.
